parsed.notes:
The requirements section defaults to required; the Nice to have section is optional. The inline plus makes C++ optional.
Alternative group 2 also includes unmapped Argo Workflows; comparable distributed ML tooling adds no additional taxonomy skill.
Argo Workflows is not Argo CD. Its qualifying mention is in Nice to have, regardless of its appearances in responsibilities.
System design is provisionally mapped to software-architecture; optimization in distributed environments is provisionally mapped to distributed-systems. Both mappings are flagged for review.
Kubernetes scheduling, resource management, controllers, and pod lifecycle are treated literally as details of the Kubernetes requirement, not separate taxonomy skills.
Systems debugging is not mapped to Software Testing; building training infrastructure is not treated as model training experience.
No years, explicit seniority, or lead/mentoring duty are stated. Track record alone is not treated as the guide's specific proven experience signal.
No German-language or degree requirement is stated.
